**CustomAchievements 1.12.0** — for Paper 1.21.4 (Java 21). Drop the jar into
your server's `plugins/` folder. New config options are merged into your
existing `config.yml` automatically on first startup.

### Added

- **"Break any 10,000 blocks" now credits the blocks you'd already broken.**
  An objective targeting `ANY` had nothing to seed from, because Minecraft keeps
  no overall "blocks mined" counter — the server counts one row per block and
  never adds them up. Those rows are now totalled, so a player with 4,000 stone
  and 1,500 dirt starts a "break 10,000 blocks" achievement at **5,500** instead
  of 0.

  The same applies to placing any block, crafting any item and picking up any
  item.

  `ITEM_CONSUME` targeting `ANY` is deliberately left unseeded: the statistic
  behind it counts every *use* of an item — blocks placed, tools swung — so its
  total across everything is not "how much has this player eaten and drunk".
  Seeding it would put a confidently wrong number on the objective.

### Upgrading

If a player already joined under an earlier version, their "any block" objective
was marked as seeded when it had nothing to offer, and won't be retried on its
own. Run:

```
/ca backfill <player> redo
```

That re-reads the statistics and credits the total. Seeding never lowers
progress, so it's safe to run.
